```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# load libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)

```

## Load Data


```{r load_data}

ec_data = read.csv("ec_manuscript_data.csv", row.names = 1)


```

Convert into HBMAP format for later use:
```{r}

# define target regions of interest
targets = c("PFC", "ORB", "MO", "ACA", "SS", "VIS", "PTL", "RSC")
R = length(targets)

# subset by target area + brain metadata column
ec_targets = ec_data %>% select(all_of(c(targets, "brain")))

# now we can convert to the standard hbmap input format
EC8_new = lapply(unique(ec_targets$brain), function(cat){
  t(ec_targets[ec_targets$brain==cat,1:R])
})

EC8_EC_label <- lapply(unique(ec_data$brain), function(cat){
  
  ec_data[ec_data$brain==cat,]$EC

})

```

We also load the HBMAP results for the ec_data.

```{r mcmc_unique}

mcmc_unique_EC8 = readRDS("ec_hbmap_results.rds")

```

Extract Motif Allocations, and add to barcode count matrix as new column.
```{r}

EC8_Z_reordered = mcmc_unique_EC8$Z

ec_data$allocation = unlist(EC8_Z_reordered)

```

## Define Function

```{r heatmap_function}

pp.standard.ordering.EC <- function(Y,
                                  Z,
                                  regions.name = NULL,
                                  title = '',
                                  EC_label){


  # get the maximum number of clusters in the data
  J <- max(unlist(Z)) 
  
  # total number of regions in the data
  R <- nrow(Y[[1]])

  if(is.null(regions.name)){

    regions.name <- paste('region', 1:R)
  }

  # combine transposed brain bc matrices together
  Y.cbind <- do.call(cbind, Y) 
  
  # calculate projection strengths from the barcode counts in Y.cbind
  Y.prop.cbind <- matrix(as.vector(Y.cbind)/rep(colSums(Y.cbind), each = R),
                         nrow = R)
  

  # flatten EC assignments into a single long list
  EC_label_combine <- unlist(EC_label) 
  
  # get the total number of neurons in every cluster.
  N.j <- sapply(1:J,
                function(j) length(which(unlist(Z)==j)))
  

  # Re-ordered projection strength
  df0 <- lapply(1:J, # iterate over every motif
                function(j){

                  # Projection strengths of neurons in cluster j
                  mx0 <- matrix(Y.prop.cbind[,which(unlist(Z)==j)],
                                nrow = R)
                  # extract neurons in motif-j from the combined proj str matrix

                  # EC labels
                  EC_label_j <- EC_label_combine[which(unlist(Z)==j)]

                  # Projection strengths of LEC neurons in cluster j
                  mx0_LEC <- matrix(mx0[,which(EC_label_j == 'LEC')],
                                    nrow = R)

                  # Projection strengths of MEC neurons in cluster j
                  mx0_MEC <- matrix(mx0[,which(EC_label_j == 'MEC')],
                                    nrow = R)

                  strong.proj.j <- which(rowSums(mx0) == max(rowSums(mx0)))[1]

                  # Reorder projecting strengths for LEC and MEC
                  mx0_LEC <- matrix(mx0_LEC[,order(mx0_LEC[strong.proj.j,])],
                                    nrow = R)

                  mx0_MEC <- matrix(mx0_MEC[,order(mx0_MEC[strong.proj.j,])],
                                    nrow = R)

                  cbind(mx0_LEC, -mx0_MEC)

                })

  df0 <- do.call(cbind, df0)

  # Convert to data frame for plotting
  Y.prop.df <- data.frame(region = rep(regions.name,
                                       ncol(Y.prop.cbind)),

                          neuron = rep(1:ncol(Y.prop.cbind),
                                       each = length(regions.name)),

                          projection.strength = as.vector(df0))


  Y.prop.df %>%
    ggplot(mapping = aes(x = factor(region, levels = regions.name),
                         y = neuron,
                         fill = projection.strength))+
    geom_tile()+
    theme_bw()+
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c('#CB6400','white', '#16697A'),
                         values = scales::rescale(c(-1, 0, 1)),
                         limits = c(-1,1))+
    guides(fill=guide_legend(title="projection strength"))+
    xlab('region')+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
          plot.title = element_text(size=12),
          plot.background = element_blank() ,
          panel.grid.major = element_blank() ,
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank() ,
          panel.border = element_blank() ,
          panel.background = element_blank()) +
    #draws x and y axis line
    theme(axis.line = element_line(color = 'black'))+
    ylab('neurons')+

    geom_hline(yintercept = cumsum(N.j)[-length(cumsum(N.j))],
               color = 'blue',
               linetype = 'dashed',
               linewidth = 0.05)+

    ggtitle(title)+
    scale_fill_gradient2(high = '#16697A', mid = "white", low = '#DB6400')


}


```


## Generate Chart
```{r}

pp.standard.ordering.EC(Y = EC8_new,
                        Z = mcmc_unique_EC8$Z,
                        regions.name = rownames(EC8_new[[1]]),
                        EC_label = EC8_EC_label)

```
